2610.10201.title: GAGR-Lab: Evaluating Joint Spatial-Geometric and Analytic Function Reasoning
2610.10201.paper_summary: Joint spatial-geometric and analytic function reasoning requires translating a perceived spatial configuration into a symbolic function whose executed curve satisfies geometric constraints. We present GAGR-Lab, a framework for measuring this capability through Cartesian game scenes, explicit function semantics, and authoritative Rust trajectory execution. It distinguishes spatial perception, metric grounding, geometric relations, function interpretation, function construction, and constrained synthesis. We specify four configurable scene-difficulty presets and a prospective 24-cell diagnostic design, while reporting only the subset actually evaluated. A bounded pilot of one hosted model (Llama 3.2 11B Vision Instruct) using two API credentials as execution replicas yields 72 balanced games with 432 attempts, 429 valid provider responses, and no target hits; exploratory ordinary-function prompt variants also fail to hit, while the structured localization interface yields no scoreable outputs. A privileged analytic search control independently succeeds on 600 directional cases from 300 generated scenes, with exact repeatability and 1,200 successful vertical-reflection or translation checks. The framework separates serving reliability, symbolic compliance, and geometric success, and preserves exact model-visible inputs and realized paths. A staged protocol outlines diagnostic calibration, held-out replication, multi-model comparison, and paired robustness tests. The contribution is an operational research framework with an executed pilot and a clearly identified prospective study plan; the full difficulty matrix and comparative model results remain untested.
2610.10201.paper_summary_zh: 聯合空間幾何與分析函數推理需要將感知的空間配置轉換為一個符號函數，其執行的曲線滿足幾何約束。<lb/>我們提出了 GAGR-Lab，一個通過笛卡爾遊戲場景、明確的函數語義和權威的 Rust 軌跡執行來測量這一能力的框架。<lb/>它區分了空間感知、度量基礎、幾何關係、函數解釋、函數構造和受限綜合。<lb/>我們指定了四個可配置的場景難度預設和一個前瞻性的 24 單元診斷設計，同時僅報告實際評估的子集。<lb/>一個有界的試點模型（Llama 3.2 11B Vision Instruct）使用兩個 API 憑證作為執行副本，產生了 72 個平衡遊戲，共 432 次嘗試，429 次有效的提供者回應，且沒有目標命中；探索性的普通函數提示變體也未能命中，而結構化定位界面未產生可計分的輸出。<lb/>一個特權的分析搜索控制在 300 個生成場景中的 600 個方向案例上獨立成功，具有精確的重複性和 1,200 次成功的垂直反射或平移檢查。<lb/>該框架分離了服務可靠性、符號合規性和幾何成功，並保留了精確的模型可見輸入和實現路徑。<lb/>一個分階協議概述了診斷校準、保留複製、多模型比較和配對穩健性測試。<lb/>這項貢獻是一個運營研究框架，具有執行的試點和明確識別的前瞻性研究計劃；完整的難度矩陣和比較模型結果仍未經測試。
